verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṁ okkamayato.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of falling asleep unmindful and unaware.

verses.pali: Dukkhaṁ supati, dukkhaṁ paṭibujjhati, pāpakaṁ supinaṁ passati, devatā na rakkhanti, asuci muccati.
verses.english: You sleep badly and wake miserably. You have bad dreams. The deities don’t protect you. And you emit semen.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa niddaṁ okkamayato.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of falling asleep unmindful and unaware.

verses.pali: Pañcime, bhikkhave, ānisaṁsā upaṭṭhitassatissa sampajānassa niddaṁ okkamayato.
verses.english: There are these five benefits of falling asleep mindful and aware.

verses.pali: Sukhaṁ supati, sukhaṁ paṭibujjhati, na pāpakaṁ supinaṁ passati, devatā rakkhanti, asuci na muccati.
verses.english: You sleep at ease and wake happily. You don’t have bad dreams. The deities protect you. And you don’t emit semen.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā upaṭṭhitassatissa sampajānassa niddaṁ okkamayato”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits of falling asleep mindful and aware.”
